text: AI is changing the way work gets done. Today, a candidate can build more, solve faster, and deliver impressive results with AI. But for hiring teams, evaluating the person behind that work has become a whole new challenge.
Meet VibeLevel Screening. An AI-era assessment platform designed to help hiring teams look beyond the final result and understand how candidates think, work with AI, and contribute.

Candidates take on realistic, role-specific challenges in a dedicated workspace with Claude Code built in. They explore the problem, work through solutions, and collaborate with AI in an environment that reflects how work actually happens today.
But completing the task is only part of the picture. VibeLevel evaluates candidates across four dimensions.
Core Skills reveals how well they apply their knowledge.
Working with AI shows how effectively they collaborate with AI and evaluate its output.
Ownership highlights how they approach decisions and take responsibility.
And Human Contribution reveals the judgment and value they bring beyond AI-generated work.

The experience continues beyond the assessment. Candidates complete a short AI-led interview, giving hiring teams another opportunity to understand their reasoning, knowledge, and ability to explain their work.

Once the evaluation is complete, recruiters get a comprehensive assessment report. From overall performance and skill scores to AI collaboration insights, Code Review, and Video Q&A, every section adds another layer of understanding.
The Interview Guide turns identified strengths and gaps into focused questions for the next conversation.
Go beyond what candidates deliver. Understand how they think, work, and contribute.
VibeLevel Screening. Hire for the skills that matter in the AI era.
